integrity: All 19,683 matrices and every idempotent transition were enumerated exactly modulo 3 from the packaged verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: The exact theorem is confined to \(M_3(\mathbb F_3)^+\); no claim is made for other fields or larger matrix sizes. The width census is an exhaustive finite computation, while the extremal similarity classification is algebraic.
title: Exact idempotent-word width five for \(M_3(\mathbb F_3)^+\)
